Effect of ferulic acid on the root growth of ryegrass

Source: R/data.R
ryegrass.Rd

The root length of perennial ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.) for several concentrations of ferulic acid; part of a study of the joint action of phenolic acids on root growth inhibition.

Usage

ryegrass

Format

A data frame with 24 rows and 2 variables:

rootl

root length (cm)

conc

concentration of ferulic acid (mM)

Source

Inderjit, Streibig, J. C. and Olofsdotter, M. (2002) Joint action of phenolic acid mixtures and its significance in allelopathy research. Physiologia Plantarum, 114, 422–428; from the package drcData.

Examples

mod <- drmTMB(rootl ~ conc, data = ryegrass, model = "loglogistic",
              start = c(b1 = 0, b5 = 0), fix = c(b1 = TRUE, b5 = TRUE))
ed(mod, c(10, 50, 90))
#> Effective dose estimates:
#> 
#>        Estimate Std.Error
#> 10:lf1     1.34     0.189
#> 50:lf1     3.26     0.196
#> 90:lf1     7.94     1.055
